blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video world models enable candidate actions to be evaluated through imagined outcomes, but high predicted rewards can favor trajectories with poor execution quality. We introduce Trusting Imagined Futures (TIF), an offline supervision selection method for vision-language-action (VLA) post-training that audits predicted rewards using execution feedback. A multidimensional reward model predicts a utility score for candidate ranking and five dimensions of execution quality. An auditor uses reward predictions and uncertainty to identify overestimation patterns learned from paired imagined videos and real executions. TIF accepts the candidate with the highest predicted utility when its advantage over the existing trajectory exceeds a margin and its audit risk passes a threshold; otherwise, it retains the existing supervision. The retained real trajectories then supervise behavior cloning. Across four LIBERO suites and three training seeds, TIF achieves a mean success rate of 76.25%, improving over training on the existing trajectories by 3.00 percentage points with the same trajectory count and training budget. Adding audit gating yields 1.47 percentage points with the reward model and advantage margin held fixed. The gains persist against advantage ranking and logistic regression risk selection at matched replacement counts. On recorded videos from three real robot tasks, TIF increases clean completion among selected trajectories from 58.33% to 70.00% across 60 candidate pools.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型能够通过想象的结果来评价候选行动,但高预测的奖励可以有利于执行质量差的轨迹. 我们引入了 " 信任想象未来 " (TIF),这是视觉语言行动(VLA)培训后的一种离线监督选择方法,通过执行反馈对奖励进行审核。 一个多层面的奖励模式预测候选人排名的效用分数和执行质量的五个方面. 一名审计员利用奖励预测和不确定性来确定从配对的想象视频和真实处决中吸取的过高估计模式。 当候选人对现有轨迹的优势超过比值,而且其审计风险超过门槛时,TIF接受候选人的预期效用最高;否则,它保留现有的监督。 保留了真实的轨迹,然后监督行为克隆. 在四个LIBERO套房和三个培训种子中,TIF取得了76.25%的平均成功率,比现有轨迹培训提高了3.00个百分点,其轨迹计算和培训预算相同。 加上审计标值的产量1.47个百分点,奖励模式和保持的优势幅度固定不变。 优势排名和后勤回归风险选择在相应的重置计数上持续得分。 在三个真正的机器人任务录制的视频中,TIF将60个候选集合中选定轨道的清洁完成率从58.33%提高到70.0%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, providing pretrained policies that can be adapted to different tasks [ 2 , 20 , 9 , 1 ] .
When post-training relies on imitation learning, the quality of the supervision trajectories directly affects the behaviors the policy learns.
Available trajectories vary in task progress and execution quality, and imitating them can cause the policy to reproduce undesirable behaviors.
Selecting suitable supervision trajectories is therefore important for VLA post-training.
blocks.zh:
Vision-language-Action(VLA)模型从视觉观测和语言指令中生成机器人动作,提供经过预先训练的政策,可以适应不同的任务[2,20,9,1].
当训练后依赖于模仿学习时,监督轨迹的质量会直接影响政策所学习的行为.
可用的轨迹在任务进度和执行质量上各有不同,模仿这些轨迹会导致政策再现不良行为.
因此,选择适当的监督轨迹对于职业道德协会的后期培训很重要。

blocks.en:
Video world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions, providing imagined outcomes for behavior evaluation [ 22 , 26 ] .
A reward model scores these outcomes to compare candidates and support policy learning [ 26 , 23 ] .
When imagined outcomes are used to select supervision for VLA post-training, reward ranking identifies candidates with higher predicted utility.
Accepting such a candidate as a replacement also requires assessing whether its predicted advantage over the existing trajectory is trustworthy.
blocks.zh:
视频世界模型预测候选行动的视觉后果,为行为评价提供想象的结果[22,26].
奖励模式对这些结果进行评分,以比较候选人和支持政策学习[26、23]。
当用想象的结果来选择对志愿军后期培训的监督时,奖励排名将确定具有较高预期效用的候选人。
接受这种候选人作为替补,还需要评估其相对于现有轨迹的预期优势是否值得信赖。

blocks.en:
An apparently successful grasp or task completion in an imagined video may correspond to an unstable grasp, a collision, or an incorrect object interaction during real execution.
Errors in world model predictions and reward estimates can give such candidates high scores [ 5 , 8 ] .
When they replace existing trajectories as behavior cloning targets, these evaluation errors can cause the policy to learn undesirable behaviors.
We study whether auditing rewards predicted from imagined outcomes improves supervision selection and subsequent policy learning (Fig. 1 ).
We evaluate this question using fixed candidate pools with matched executions.
blocks.zh:
在被想象的视频中,一个显然成功的抓取或任务完成,可能与一个不稳定的抓取,碰撞,或一个不正确的对象在实际执行过程中的交互对应.
世界模型预测和奖励估计的错误可以给这些候选人高分[5,8].
当它们取代了现有的轨迹作为行为克隆目标时,这些评价错误会导致政策学习不良行为.
我们研究从想象结果中预测的审计回报是否改善了监督选择和随后的政策学习(图1)。
我们用固定候选人集合和相应的处决来评估这个问题。

blocks.en:
We propose Trusting Imagined Futures (TIF), which uses real execution feedback to train a risk auditor that complements reward scores when deciding whether to accept candidate trajectories as supervision.
The reward model evaluates imagined videos along five dimensions: task progress, goal correctness, manipulation quality, safety, and execution stability.
It jointly predicts a utility score for candidate ranking.
The auditor learns from discrepancies between these predictions and the corresponding real execution outcomes to identify candidates with high predicted scores but poor execution quality.
TIF first selects the candidate with the highest predicted utility.
It accepts this candidate if its predicted advantage over the existing supervision trajectory (Source) exceeds a margin and its audit risk falls below a threshold; otherwise, it retains Source.
We then update the VLA through behavior cloning using paired observations and actions from the retained real execution trajectories.
blocks.zh:
我们提议信任想象的未来(TIF),它利用真正的执行反馈来训练一个风险审计员,在决定是否接受候选人的轨迹作为监督时补充奖励分数.
奖励模式对想象中的视频进行了五方面评价:任务进度、目标正确性、操纵质量、安全性以及执行稳定性。
它共同预测候选人排名的效用分.
审计员从这些预测与相应实际执行结果之间的差异中吸取了教训,以查明预期得分高但执行质量差的候选人。
TIF首先选择预想功用最高的候选人.
如果它相对于现有监督轨迹(来源)的预期优势超过比值,而且其审计风险低于门槛值,则它接受该候选人;否则它保留源。
然后我们通过行为克隆来更新VLA, 利用保留的真正执行轨迹的对等观察和行动.

blocks.en:
We construct 32,000 pairs of real executions and imagined videos across four LIBERO suites [ 14 ] , using real execution outcomes to supervise the reward model and auditor.
Candidate pools are collected offline, with recorded executions providing labels, evaluation outcomes, and behavior cloning targets.
Selection uses predicted scores and diagnostic information from imagined videos to accept a replacement or retain Source.
At deployment, only the updated VLA is required.
blocks.zh:
我们用真实的处决结果来监督奖励模式和审计员。
候选人人才库是离线收集的,有记录的处决提供了标签、评价结果和行为克隆目标。
选择使用预测分数和来自想象视频的诊断信息来接受替换或保留源.
在部署时,只需要更新的志愿军。

blocks.en:
Across four LIBERO suites and three training seeds, TIF achieves a mean success rate of 76.25%, exceeding behavior cloning using only Source trajectories by 3.00 percentage points with the same number of training trajectories and behavior cloning budget.
With the reward model and advantage margin held fixed, adding audit gating improves mean success by 1.47 percentage points.
When the number of replacements is fixed, TIF still outperforms ranking by predicted advantage and selecting candidates by risk estimated through logistic regression.
blocks.zh:
在四个LIBERO套房和三个培训种子中,TIF取得了76.25%的平均成功率,仅使用源轨距就超过3.00个百分点,培训轨距和行为克隆预算相同。
奖励模式和优势差值固定下来,加上审计指标,成功率将增加1.47个百分点。
当替换人数固定后,临时投资框架通过预测优势和通过后勤回归估计的风险来选择候选人,仍然比排名好。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We propose TIF, a supervision auditing method that learns from matched real executions when rewards predicted from imagined videos overestimate execution quality. TIF combines this risk with a candidate’s predicted advantage to decide whether to accept a replacement or retain the existing supervision. • We develop a multidimensional reward model for candidate ranking and risk auditing. The model jointly predicts five dimensions of execution quality and a utility score. Utility predictions rank candidates, while dimension predictions and their uncertainty provide information for auditing. • We show that the auditor identifies discrepancies between high predicted rewards and poor execution outcomes. Comparisons with fixed replacement counts and downstream post-training experiments further show that using audit risk improves supervision selection and policy success.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出TIF, 一种监督审计方法, 综合投资框架将这一风险与候选人的预期优势结合起来,以决定是否接受替换或保留现有的监督。 我们为候选人的排名和风险审计制定了多层面的奖励模式。 该模型共同预测了五个层面的执行质量和效用分数. 效用预测对候选人进行排名,而维度预测及其不确定性为审计提供了信息。 我们显示,审计员查明了高预测的奖励与低执行结果之间的差异。 与固定重置计数和下游培训后试验的比较进一步表明,利用审计风险可以改善监督选择和政策成功。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
OpenVLA-OFT improves supervised adaptation through changes to action decoding, representation, and learning objectives [ 10 ] , while GRAPE aligns policies with preferences over successful and failed trajectories [ 24 ] .
RIPT-VLA and VLA-RL use environment interaction for reinforcement learning, with sparse success rewards and process rewards, respectively [ 19 , 15 ] .
WMPO reduces reliance on real environment interaction by optimizing policies through imagined rollouts from a video world model [ 26 ] .
WoVR addresses accumulated prediction errors through keyframe initialization and joint updates of the policy and world model [ 8 ] .
WoVR+ extends this approach to multiple views, proprioceptive states, and training within individual stages of longer tasks [ 25 ] .
TIF uses imagined outcomes to evaluate fixed candidate actions and select real execution trajectories for behavior cloning.
blocks.zh:
OpenVLA-OFT通过改变动作编解码,表现和学习目标来改进有监督的适应[10],而GRAPE则将政策与优于成功和失败轨迹的偏好相配合[24].
RIPT-VLA和VLA-RL利用环境互动加强学习,分别获得很少的成功奖和过程奖[19,15].
WMPO通过想象中的从视频世界模式推出来优化政策来减少对真实环境互动的依赖[26].
WoVR通过关键框架初始化和联合更新政策和世界模型来解决累积的预测错误[8].
WoVR+将这种方法推广到多种观点,自发状态,以及在较长任务的各个阶段的培训[25].
TIF使用所想象的结果来评价固定的候选行为,并选择真正的执行轨迹来进行行为克隆.

blocks.en:
Robometer learns rewards through progress supervision within trajectories and preference comparisons across trajectories [ 13 ] , while RoboReward augments supervision with negative and partial completion examples constructed through counterfactual relabeling and temporal clipping [ 11 ] .
RynnValue learns temporal distance to task completion and converts its predictions into dense rewards [ 7 ] .
During inference, V-GPS reranks actions using a value function learned through offline reinforcement learning [ 16 ] , and RoVer uses process rewards to guide candidate expansion and selection [ 4 ] .
RARM gates progress rewards according to confidence in matching execution clips to a reference demonstration [ 21 ] .
TIF uses matched simulator executions to supervise predictions of execution quality from imagined videos, providing a utility score for ranking and five dimension predictions for auditing.
blocks.zh:
RoboReward通过在轨迹中的进展监督以及不同轨迹之间的偏好比较来学习奖励,而RoboReward则通过反事实重贴标签和时间剪接,用负和部分完成实例来强化监督。
RynnValue学习时间距离完成任务,并将其预测转化为密集的奖励[7].
在推论期间,V-GPS使用通过离线强化学习学到的值函数对动作进行重新排序[16],而Rover使用过程奖励来指导候选人的扩展和选择[4].
RARM门根据对将执行片段与参考演示相匹配的信心递增奖励[21].
TIF使用相匹配的模拟处决来监督从所想象的视频对执行质量的预测,为排名提供了实用分数,为审计提供了5个维度预测.

blocks.en:
Recent methods use reliability estimates to control how imagined outcomes influence policy learning.
WISE filters candidate groups using reward differences, ranking consistency, and reward variation across repeated imaginations, then updates the policy using relative advantages within each group [ 23 ] .
HaWMPO learns video reliability from visual, geometric, and motion discrepancies against observed executions, together with image quality metrics, and adjusts reinforcement learning rewards through Reward-Soft [ 3 ] .
MeRL uses visual prediction and reward proxy errors to regulate imagination length and data proportion, as well as sampling probabilities and training weights for individual chunks [ 12 ] .
TIF learns the risk of reward overestimation from matched executions, targeting cases with high predicted utility, low executed utility, and a substantial gap between them.
This risk and the predicted advantage over Source determine whether to accept the candidate with the highest predicted utility or retain the existing supervision.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法使用可靠性估计来控制所想象的结果如何影响政策学习。
WISE利用奖励差异,排名一致性,以及重复想象的奖励差异,过滤候选团体,然后利用每个团体内的相对优势来更新政策[23].
HAWMPO从视觉、几何和运动差异以及图像质量测量中学习视频可靠性,并通过Reward-Soft[3]调整强化学习奖励。
MeRL使用可视预测和奖励代理错误来调节想象的长度和数据比例,以及单个块的采样概率和训练权重 [12].
TIF了解了对相应处决的奖励过高的风险,针对的是预期效用高、执行效用低以及两者之间存在巨大差距的案件。
这一风险和相对于来源的预期优势决定是接受预期效用最高的候选人,还是保留现有的监督。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 2 , TIF combines candidate utility prediction with reward risk auditing to select supervision trajectories for VLA post-training.
We first train a multidimensional reward model using matched execution outcomes, then train an auditor on discrepancies between its predictions and those outcomes.
During selection, the candidate with the highest predicted utility replaces Source only if its predicted advantage exceeds a margin and its audit risk falls below a threshold; otherwise, Source is retained.
Observations and actions from all valid steps of the retained real execution trajectories are then used for behavior cloning.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,综合投资框架将候选公用事业预测和奖励风险审计结合起来,为志愿军后培训选择监督轨迹。
我们首先利用相应的执行结果培训一个多层面的奖励模式,然后就预测与这些结果之间的差异培训一名审计员。
在甄选期间,预计效用最高的候选人替换 只有在预测优势超过比值,且审计风险低于门槛值的情况下,才使用源;否则,保留源.
然后,从保留的真正执行轨迹的所有有效步骤中观察和行动,用于行为克隆。

blocks.en: 3.2 Reward Supervision from Execution
blocks.zh: 3.2 奖励对执行的监督

We therefore derive five continuous labels from each candidate’s execution: 𝐫 i , k = ( P i , k , G i , k , M i , k , S i , k , E i , k ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 5 \mathbf{r}_{i,k}=(P_{i,k},G_{i,k},M_{i,k},S_{i,k},E_{i,k})\in[0,1]^{5} ,

blocks.en:
Task progress measures advancement toward completion, while goal correctness measures alignment with the object and goal specified by the instruction.
Manipulation quality measures the effectiveness of grasping, transport, and placement.
The safety proxy captures risks associated with abnormal contact, excessive actions, and abrupt state changes.

blocks.en:
We next evaluate whether the trajectories selected in Sec. 4.3 improve policy learning, using task success after behavior cloning.
With the same trajectory count and behavior cloning budget, TIF achieves an average success rate of 76.25%, exceeding Source by 3.00 percentage points ( Tab. 3 ).
Training directly on greedy branches or random candidates does not outperform Source, whereas reward selection improves average success.
With the reward model and advantage margin held fixed, adding the audit gate yields a further gain of 1.47 percentage points, with improvements across all three training seeds.
TIF achieves the highest success on Spatial, Object, and Long.
Its largest gain over Source is 5.73 percentage points on Long, while success on Goal decreases by 1.00 percentage point.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented TIF, which combines multidimensional reward evaluation with risk auditing learned from execution feedback to select supervision trajectories for VLA post-training.
The reward model provides utility predictions for ranking and dimension predictions with uncertainty for auditing.
The retained real trajectories supervise behavior cloning.
With the same trajectory count and training budget, TIF improves average success across four LIBERO suites from 73.25% to 76.25%.
Dimensional supervision ablations and comparisons at fixed replacement counts support the contributions of execution quality information and risk auditing to policy learning.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了综合投资框架,它将多层面的奖励评价与从执行反馈中吸取的风险审计结合起来,为志愿军后培训选择监督轨迹。
奖励模式为排名和维度预测提供了效用预测,对审计提供了不确定性。
保留下来的正轨监督行为克隆.
由于轨迹计算和培训预算相同,TIF提高了四个LIBERO套房的平均成功率,从73.25%提高到76.25%.
在固定重置计数中进行规模化的分级监督和比较有助于执行质量信息和风险审计对政策学习的贡献。

blocks.en:
Experiments use OpenVLA and LIBERO.
Future work will examine other policies and benchmarks, and the execution feedback needed to adapt the auditor when models or candidate distributions change.
blocks.zh:

今后的工作将审查其他政策和基准以及执行方面所需的反馈,以便在模式或候选人分配发生变化时调整审计员。

blocks.en: A.1 Tasks and Data Splits

blocks.en:
Our experiments cover the Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long suites of LIBERO, with ten tasks per suite [ 14 ] .
We construct a component dataset for training and evaluating the reward model and auditor, and a natural candidate dataset for supervision selection and policy post-training.
In both datasets, candidates associated with the same initial state form a candidate pool.
Each candidate has a recorded execution trajectory and a corresponding imagined video.
Table S1 summarizes the dataset sizes and their roles.

我们为培训和评价奖励模式和审计员构建了一个组件数据集,并为监督甄选和政策后培训构建了一个自然候选人数据集。

每个候选人都有记录的行刑轨迹和相应的被想象的视频.

Data splits are grouped by source trajectory.
Initial states derived from the same source trajectory, together with all their candidates, are assigned to the same split.
When records have multiple levels of derivation, we trace their provenance back to the original trajectory.
The natural validation and test sets inherit the validation and test provenance assignments of the component dataset, respectively.
Neither set shares source trajectories with the training data of the reward model or auditor.
The natural training set may share source trajectories with the reward training data.

从同一源轨迹衍生出来的初始状态,连同其所有候选人,被分配到同一分位.

自然验证和测试集分别继承了组件数据集的验证和测试出处分配.

blocks.en:

Policy post-training uses the natural training set and retains one execution trajectory per initial state, giving 800 trajectories in total and 200 per suite.

blocks.en: A.2 Candidate Construction and Execution

blocks.en:
The component dataset contains four controlled candidates per initial state, providing examples with different execution quality.
Each natural candidate pool contains five candidates: Source, one greedy branch, and three sampled branches.

blocks.en:
Source is an existing fixed action proposal associated with the initial state, obtained from either a LIBERO demonstration or saved policy action records.
For demonstration sources, we extract the action sequence following the corresponding starting point.
For historical policy sources, we retrieve the saved actions.
The construction of historical policy records includes extending a sequence by repeating its final action, as well as repeating a saved single action.
We then execute Source in its associated scene and initial state, recording observations, actions, and execution feedback.

All branches within a pool start from the same scene and initial state.
Each sequence contains at most eight control commands executed at 20 Hz and stops upon reaching its prescribed length or environment termination.
For a branch that terminates early, we retain the valid executed prefix.
After collection, the action sequences and their execution records remain fixed for subsequent video generation, evaluation, and supervision selection.

blocks.en: A.3 Pairing Imagined Videos with Executions

blocks.en:
We use Cosmos-Predict2 2B to generate an imagined video for each candidate [ 17 ] .
Generation is conditioned on the initial visual observation and the recorded action sequence, with an adapter using the initial proprioceptive state to construct the required world model conditioning.
For candidates that terminate early, generation uses the valid action prefix.

blocks.en:
This section supplements the real-robot candidate selection
experiment in the main paper.
We use a JAKA S5 manipulator to record candidates with
different execution quality on three tabletop tasks.
Recorded execution videos are used to evaluate reward ranking
and audit-based selection.
blocks.zh:
本节补充实际机器人候选人选择
主论文中的实验。
我们用JAKA S5操纵器记录候选人
在三个桌面任务上执行质量不同。
录音的行刑录像用来评价奖励排名
和基于审计的选择。

blocks.en: G.1 Tasks and Candidate Pools
blocks.zh: G.1 任务和候选人人才库

blocks.en:
The three tasks are pushing a block across a target line,
placing exactly one cup, and relocating a specified cup.
Each task contains 20 candidate pools.
Each pool contains five physically executed trajectories,
one designated as Source, yielding 60 pools and
300 execution trajectories in total.

blocks.en:

completion quality, and execution deviations,
providing alternative behaviors for the same task.

giving 60 selections per method.

blocks.en: G.2 Video Evaluation and Candidate Selection
blocks.zh: G.2 视频评价和候选人甄选

blocks.en:
The real-robot experiment uses recorded execution videos
as visual inputs.
Executions of different quality provide candidate outcomes
for comparing reward evaluation and audit selection
in the JAKA setting.
blocks.zh:
真机器人实验使用录制的处决视频
作为视觉输入。
不同质量的执行提供候选结果
比较奖励评价和审计选择
在JAKA环境。

blocks.en:
Both methods use the same reward model.
Reward-only selects the candidate with the highest
predicted utility.
TIF uses the same auditor and acceptance rule as in
the main paper.
It first fixes the candidate with the highest predicted utility,
then checks whether its predicted advantage over Source
exceeds 0.15 0.15 and its audit risk is at most 0.50 0.50 .
The candidate replaces Source when both conditions hold;
otherwise, Source is retained.
Model parameters and selection thresholds remain unchanged
throughout the real-robot evaluation.
blocks.zh:
两种方法都采用相同的奖励模式.
仅奖励选择最高的候选人
预测效用。
TIF 使用相同的审计员和验收规则
主报.
它首先使候选人拥有最高的预期效用,
然后检查它相对于源的预期优势
超过0.15,其审计风险最多为0.50 0.50。
替换候选人 两种条件都存在时的来源;
否则,保留资料来源。
模型参数和选择阈值保持不变
整个真正的机器人评估。
